Refactored the CSS architecture by creating modular components for Manga, Novels, About, Gallery, Music and Extra Stories pages, replacing the monolithic 2000+ line stylesheet with maintainable, page-specific styles.
Improved the Music Player with unique track ID system across albums, fixing the issue where clicking a track from one album would incorrectly display the title from a different album's first track.
Enhanced the Music Player's compact favorites view with a more Spotify-inspired design, improving visual consistency and mobile responsiveness.
fixes: Fixed incorrect track title display in Music Player when switching between albums with duplicate track IDs.
Fixed Music Player not clearing the current track display when exiting album details without a track playing.
Resolved Music Player UI not updating properly when navigating back to the library view.
notes: This update focuses on improving the mobile gallery experience, streamlining the codebase through CSS modularization, and fixing critical Music Player issues with track identification and UI state management. The track ID system now uses unique identifiers (e.g., 'ost-1', 'opening-1') to prevent cross-album title confusion.
